audio.note: Proposed baseline per directive 17.8. Confirm suitability for the intended placement.

audio_results.minimum_count_note: PROPOSED (WW-21, 2026-10-11). This is the COUNT OF THE FIVE GATE NAMES THE PLAN ALREADY NAMES -- not a measured limit, and not a number Trevor set. Labelled PROPOSED in the code, in the CHANGELOG and in the test docstring; it moves only when the plan's own gate list moves.
audio_results.note: WW-21 total fail-closed aggregation/evidence-binding boundary. These five results are the five delivered-audio gates the operator plan already names (D1 real rap, D2 story start, D3 both pace changes, D4 three audibly different versions, D5 more than one character voice). WW-21 measures no audio and claims no audio-quality outcome: it is NOT a sixth gate. It requires a complete, nonempty set, each result bound to the export digest, creative revision and profile revision it was produced against; missing, empty, unknown, unavailable, unmeasured, flagged, failed, malformed, stale-bound or manually relabelled evidence BLOCKS, and only PASS advances.

calibration.note: Similarity thresholds are placeholders. Calibrate against approved examples and known failures before qualification; store the calibrated thresholds and reviewer procedure here. Do not claim an uncalibrated numeric similarity score proves identity.

cta.note: Final CTA hold at least three seconds; review at 360px-wide mobile rendition within placement safe areas. OCR alone does not prove readability or identity.

lyrics.note: 100% required offer/claim/product/CTA words present and correct. Approved pronunciation mappings may change spelling in generation input, never meaning.

source: directive section 17.8 (baseline specification choices, not claims that provider outputs already pass them)

timeline.note: Round once to declared frame grid, prohibit cumulative drift. No unintended gaps, black frames or missing media.

timing.note: Measured on independently annotated sample lines. Record sample, confidence and annotation method. Low-confidence alignment requires review, never invented precision.
